title: Release 1.26.1: config outside the install, private-names via config, public scrub
head: swarm-1.26.1
body:
## Summary

- Configuration files now live outside the install checkout, with support for standard system paths and detection of misplaced configs.
- Private name filtering now reads from configuration when not explicitly provided, supporting path patterns to protect sensitive files in diffs.
- Removed product names from documentation, tests, and comments to maintain consistency in public repositories.
- Test suite isolated from local configuration to ensure consistent test behavior across different environments.

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

No ask-first gate or persisted-state mapping in this tool. Each new rule has a test that fails without it (tests/config-private-names.test.mjs).
